policy: No repository record approves this selected positive/negative expectation suite. All proposals remain outside publication evidence until explicit human approval is recorded. Negative means not entailed, not logical negation. No claim of global interpretability.

classification_policy.evidence_role: independent_semantic_expectation is a proposed competency/boundary question; mapping_axiom_regression is a redundant axiom restatement and never counts as independent semantic validation. All remain unapproved.
classification_policy.entailment_origin: source_semantics denotes logical source axioms; mapping_induced denotes the alignment, possibly together with source/target axioms. Advisory domainIncludes is not a logical domain axiom.
